# lingmo-live

Package of Lingmo's live config and calamares setting.

- 代码仓库：<https://github.com/LingmoOS/lingmo-live>
- 许可证：`ISC`
- 一句话说明的来源：debian/control（`Package: lingmo-live` 的 `Description`）
